_comment: Shared folder settings. Read by BOTH scripts/generate-images.py and
js/autoscan.js, so the two can never disagree about a folder's name or
whether it belongs in the gallery.
A folder NOT listed here still works: it joins the gallery with its own
name as the tab label. You only need an entry to override that.
label   - gallery tab wording. "" keeps the folder out of the gallery.
gallery - false keeps it out even if it has a label.
alt     - fallback photo description. {site} becomes the resort name.
galleryOrder lists the tab order. Folders not named here go last,
